## What changed

Describe the observable behavior or documentation change. Link the issue or motivating failure case when one exists.

## Change class

- [ ] Protocol
- [ ] Engine
- [ ] Adapter
- [ ] Automation
- [ ] Corpus
- [ ] Documentation

## Evidence

List the exact commands run and their results. Do not report skipped tests as a complete pass.

```text
command:
result:
```

## Compatibility and risk

- [ ] Existing public contracts are preserved, or the compatibility impact is described below.
- [ ] No secrets, private paths, customer data, or proprietary logs are included.
- [ ] English and Chinese README files changed together when user-facing README content changed.
- [ ] Generated reports do not leave timestamp-only changes in the repository.

Protocol changes only:

- [ ] A dirty case demonstrates the need.
- [ ] A compatibility note is included.
- [ ] A reference example and changelog entry are included.

## Human review

State what the maintainer must decide. Automated preflight evidence is not approval, merge authorization, or release authorization.
